title: Increment-Count Register Run
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $m$ be a codec mode, let $y$ be a bit string, let $B$ be a natural number, and let $c$ be an increment-count identifier. For a register assignment $v$ on $21$ registers, suppose every register value is at most $B$ and the value in the register associated with $c$, plus the count associated with $c$, is at most $B$. Then the codec register program can reach the next label for $c$ from its index-zero label, increasing that register by the associated count; throughout the run, its prescribed safety condition holds and every register remains at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Every register value in $v$ is at most $B$
